title: Resiliency runway and spare rotation calculator - GPU VPC
content:
Purpose:
This spreadsheet-style document is an operational calculator to size a private/VPC GPU fleet with explicit resiliency runway and a rotating spare pool. It is intended for solution architects and infra procurement when planning 12–36 month purchase waves and to set a operational spare-rotation cadence for maintenance and unexpected failures.

Quick summary (what this sheet does):
- Converts workload QPS & concurrency profiles into required active GPUs per region.
- Computes a recommended spare/rotation pool by role (hot spares for latency-critical, warm spares for batch/hybrid).
- Generates a BOM line estimate (servers, GPUs, NVMe, networking, PSUs, rails) and top-level cost per purchase wave.
- Projects runway (months of capacity remaining) under three scenarios: baseline growth, surge (x2 QPS), and failure bleed (N% offline).

ASSUMPTIONS (editable inputs):
- GPU types supported: A100-80GB (float), H100-80GB, L40-48GB (inference optimized). Use the per-GPU effective token throughput estimates in the inputs.
- Target utilization: 65% steady-state for latency-critical, 85% for batch lanes.
- Maintenance window: 2 racks offline for patching every 6 weeks unless spare pool is used.
- Spare pool policy: rotate 10% of active fleet into maintenance monthly (configurable).
- Supported RPO/SLO: 99.9% availability required; spare pool must cover single-rack failures in primary region.

INPUT PARAMETERS (editable):
CSV_INPUTS:
Region,Model,QPS_avg,Avg_tokens_per_request,Concurrency_estimate,Tokens_per_sec_per_gpu,Target_util_pct,Planned_rack_capacity_gpus
us-west-2,H100-80GB,180,120,45,12000,0.65,64
us-east-1,A100-80GB,90,200,25,9000,0.65,48
eu-central-1,L40-48GB,40,80,12,6000,0.85,32

Key calculation notes (textual):
- Effective tokens/sec demand per region = QPS_avg * Avg_tokens_per_request.
- Required GPUs (raw) = ceil((Effective tokens/sec demand) / Tokens_per_sec_per_gpu / Target_util_pct).
- Racks required = ceil(Required GPUs / Planned_rack_capacity_gpus).
- Spare pool baseline = max(ceil(Required GPUs * spare_pct), min_spare_by_region). spare_pct default = 0.10 (10%).
- Hot spare vs warm spare split: default 70/30 for latency-critical; configurable.

EXAMPLE OUTPUT TABLE (computed):
Region,Model,Tokens_per_sec_demand,Raw_required_gpus,Required_gpus_with_util,Racks_required,Recommended_spare_pool,Hot_spares,Warm_spares
us-west-2,H100-80GB,21600,3,5,1,1,1,0
us-east-1,A100-80GB,18000,3,5,1,1,1,0
eu-central-1,L40-48GB,3200,1,1,1,0,0,0

Notes on the example: numbers above are illustrative after applying target utilization and rounding policies. For production workloads we expect required GPUs in the tens to low hundreds per region; the final procurement plan should aggregate across regions for price breaks.

BOM ESTIMATE (per GPU unit basis + system overhead):
CSV_BOM:
Item,Qty_per_gpu,Unit_cost_usd,Notes
H100-80GB GPU,1,25000,premium inference SKU (vendor quoted)
A100-80GB GPU,1,15000,high-double-precision-capable
L40-48GB GPU,1,7000,inference-optimized, cheaper memory
1U inference chassis (4 GPUs),0.25,12000,includes motherboards, CPUs, rails
NVMe 4TB,0.1,800,for model cache per GPU share
Top-of-Rack 100Gbps switch,0.02,12000,shared across racks; amortized per-gpu fraction
Power/cooling overhead,0.1,600,amortized per GPU
Rack and racking,0.01,1000,amortized
Support & warranty (3yr),0.05,3000,per GPU fraction

BOM SAMPLE CALC (single-region sample):
- Active GPUs required: 120 H100 equivalent
- Spare pool (10%): 12 GPUs (hot: 8, warm:4)
- Total GPUs to purchase initially: 132
- Estimated GPU hardware cost (H100): 132 * $25,000 = $3,300,000
- Estimated system overhead (chassis, NVMe, networking): add ~18% (~$594,000)
- Total TCO hardware (capex) ~ $3.9M, plus integration/onboarding SOW (~$120k)

RUNWAY AND PURCHASE WAVE PLANNING (text + small table):
- Wave sizing rules: purchase at waves aligned to warranty cycles and quarter budgets. Use 3 waves across 12 months for smoothing.
- Maintain a two-month spare runway at all times (i.e., spare pool + available maintenance capacity should cover projected demand growth for two months).

Runway projection sample table:
Month,Projected_QPS_growth_pct,Active_capacity_gpus,Projected_required_gpus,Surplus_deficit_gpus,Action
Mar-2026,0,132,120,12,hold
Apr-2026,10,132,132,0,prepare-wave
May-2026,25,132,150,-18,procure-wave-1 (48 gpus)

FAILURE & SURGE SCENARIOS (procedural text):
- Single rack failure: Spare pool must be able to replace the capacity of the largest single rack in the region within scheduled SLA window. If racks are heterogeneous, calculate by largest-rack-GPU-count.
- 2x surge event: if QPS doubles for 1–4 hours, autoscaling should route batch to lower-cost regions and shed low-priority queries. For planning, ensure there is at least 15% burst capacity across pooled regions or pre-negotiated cloud-bursting credits.

SPARE ROTATION POLICY (recommended):
- Target spare pool: 10% of active fleet, minimum 4 GPUs per region (whichever is larger).
- Rotation cadence: move 1/3 of the spare pool through maintenance each month so every spare gets a full test cycle every 3 months.
- Lifecycle: rotate GPUs out of production into spare pool prior to vendor EOL deprecation (18 months before EOL).

PROCUREMENT CHECKLIST (actionable):
- Confirm vendor lead-times (H100: 10–16 weeks typical), include customs and logistics buffer.
- Validate power & PDU capacity per rack for 4x H100 or 8x L40 configs.
- Reserve shipping windows aligned to wave dates + staging rack count.
- Run acceptance tests in a staging VPC with 10% of purchased GPUs before full deployment.

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Decide spare_pct default (10% suggested) vs policy target for mission-critical customers (may require 15–20%).
- Confirm preferred GPU mix (H100 vs A100 vs L40) for cost/perf tradeoffs on LLMs currently in our model catalog.
- Determine budget cadence: quarterly vs biannual refresh.

ACTION ITEMS (owners):
- Priya: finalize vendor quotes and update per-unit costs (due 2026-03-12)
- Liam: run benchmark token-throughput sweep on candidate models to firm tokens/sec estimates (due 2026-03-01)
- Sofia: validate rack-level PDUs and cooling headroom with datacenter ops (due 2026-03-08)

Appendix: formula references and quick cheat-sheet:
- tokens/sec demand = QPS_avg * Avg_tokens_per_request
- required_gpus = ceil(tokens/sec demand / tokens_per_sec_per_gpu / target_util_pct)
- racks_required = ceil(required_gpus / gpus_per_rack)
- spare_pool = max(ceil(required_gpus * spare_pct), min_spare)

End of sheet. Paste this into the procurement spreadsheet as the starting tab and iterate per-region lanes.
